sentence: This project builds machine learning methods that use single-cell and 3D data to study how genetic variation affects gene regulation in rheumatoid arthritis.
This project tries to find out how rules of controlled use of cannabis work among emerging adults.
This project buys a laminar flow hood to make molecular imaging agents that detect disease and measure how patients respond to therapies.
This project studies physical activity in children after traumatic brain injury and how it relates to brain-derived neurotrophic factor and neurobehavior.
This project uses spatial transcriptomics to map the molecular mechanisms behind aberrantly spliced and mis-processed proteins in brain regions affected by Alzheimer's disease.
This project tries to find, isolate and study latently infected cells from people living with HIV who use opioids.
This project uses forward genetics to find and study genes and pathways involved in early-onset glaucoma.
This project builds a microscopy method that links metabolic changes to protein diffusion in cells in a pixel-wise manner.
This project studies how environmental carcinogens interact with retrotransposons in lung epithelial cells.
This project runs a cancer research plan to study the risk factors behind cancer burdens and cancer disparities and turns the results into clinical trials.
This project tries to find out why anaplastic thyroid cancer becomes resistant to kinase therapies.
This project builds a wearable sensor system that continuously monitors the severity of alcohol withdrawal syndrome using physiological and biochemical signals.
This project tries to understand metabolic vulnerabilities in rifampicin-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis, especially in trehalose metabolism.
This project studies how gene expression relates to projections in the mouse corticothalamic circuit using in situ sequencing-based neuroanatomical techniques.
This project builds two rapid methods to measure misfolding and degradation of protein versions in which each amino acid is substituted.
This project tries to find out which bacterial drivers let Staphylococcus aureus start and keep infection in corneal infections.
This project uses topological data analysis and machine learning on brain connectomes from neuroimaging data to classify Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how exposure to perfluorooctanoic acid disrupts serotonin metabolism in pancreatic islets and affects glucose homeostasis in pregnant mice.
This project develops non-contrast MRI methods to assess synovial inflammation in knee osteoarthritis.
This project tests hybrid closed loop pump therapy in adults with type 1 diabetes from lower income communities.
